description: Open web, select old-build, a.log and b.log (click, Shift+↓ twice) and press Delete (⌘⌫ on macOS): the sheet asks “Delete 3 items permanently?” with their names; Return doesn't delete, so press it, then the Delete button: the three go (the fixture deletes at once, so its “Deleting…” toast is gone by the next frame). Then delete cache, which can't be read: the toast stays, “Couldn't delete ‘cache’: You don't have access to /srv/site/cache”, with a dismiss button.
